errors.evidence: The description completely misrepresents the inner ring. The inner ring shows data for 'Max Ambiguity', where 'Max: 1' corresponds to 47.7%, 'Max: 2' to 14.2%, and 'Max: 3' to 7.0%. The description incorrectly assigns values (49.0%, 38.0%) and colors from the outer ring to the inner ring's categories, and also reports an incorrect value for 'Max: 3'.

The description incorrectly maps labels to values for the outer ring. In the figure, the outer ring slice for 'Std: 0.0' has a value of 49.0%, not 7.0%. The slice for 'Std: 0.47' has a value of 38.0%, not 47.7%. The description appears to have swapped values from the inner ring into the description of the outer ring.
